recap.text: Edgar is a tortoise tattooist who uses corpses for ink. He puts a dead Miss Nadine onto Signet's skin, and because of her attachment to Clint, Clint appears on the skin unasked and unbilled. Edgar maps a castle from the outside, including tunnels for Ferdinand to move without using doors. Louis works out what the tunnels are for.

Edgar uses Sense Movement level fifteen to settle Rosetta's theory about Vinata and detects a non-corporeal moving through the castle and the upward momentum of someone worshipping a god. He gives Princess Donut a tattoo that will get up and fight when she calls it. Edgar and Mordecai perform surgery on Louis while the party works above them.

beats.headline: The ink comes from the body
beats.text: Edgar is a tortoise. Edgar is also the reason Signet's tattoos are what they are, and the method is not squeamish: he works from the corpse. Miss Nadine, dead, goes onto Signet's skin as ink and comes back off it as something that moves and fights. Miss Nadine's attachment to Clint drags Clint along with her, so he turns up on the skin as well, unasked and unbilled. Nobody in the party looks surprised. There is apparently a queue for this.
beats.gist: Edgar is a tortoise tattooist who uses corpses as ink.

beats.headline: He maps the castle from outside it
beats.text: Ahead of the castle job Edgar sits well back from the building and maps the whole of it from where he is. Every room, every level, and a set of small connecting tunnels that fit nothing anyone can name. Louis is the one who works out what they are for. They are Ferdinand's, so that he can move around his own house without ever using a door.
beats.gist: Edgar maps the castle from outside, including tunnels Louis identifies as Ferdinand's secret doorless paths.

beats.headline: Sense Movement, level fifteen
beats.text: Rosetta has a theory about how Vinata keeps getting into Club Vanquisher, and Edgar is the instrument that settles it. He senses the non-corporeal moving through the castle. He also picks up upward momentum coming off the ground, which is what it looks like from below when somebody nearby worships a god for the first time.
beats.gist: Edgar uses Sense Movement to settle Rosetta's theory about Vinata and detects a first-time god worshipper.

beats.headline: A tattoo for the cat
beats.text: Rosetta, Milk and Edgar come up into the tower to work on Princess Donut. She is getting a tattoo, and given who does the ink around here, a tattoo is not decoration. It is a thing that will get up off her and fight when she calls it.
beats.gist: Rosetta, Milk and Edgar come into the tower to give Princess Donut a fighting tattoo.

beats.headline: Surgery, on a clock
beats.text: Sixty-five minutes on the floor and every member of the party has a job. Edgar's job is surgery. He and Mordecai operate on Louis while the rest of it goes on above them, and nobody has told the tortoise how long he has.
beats.gist: Edgar and Mordecai operate on Louis while the party works and the tortoise knows not his time.
